answer: A random beacon audit with a compute heartbeat stops bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a 40 POA bond to join the harbor registry. Each epoch the beacon samples agents at random; each chosen one must finish a sequential compute heartbeat in one hour. Each voyage is logged crystal-clear, so a missed heartbeat slashes the bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA for a 25 POA reward. An honest agent pays once and keeps the full reward.
